definitions.window: Filing year reference+1 to reference+3; calendar complete through 2024 required
definitions.unit: Unique application, represented by earliest valid nonwithdrawn grant through 2024
definitions.baseline: Corrected linked own applications granted strictly before reference year; no broad name rematching
definitions.citations: Distinct numeric US utility grant citations, citing grant through 2024; future-to-past violations excluded
definitions.benchmark: Full granted universe through 2024; filing-year x primary CPC3; ceil(5%) ranks, patent-ID tie break
definitions.means: Complete measurement over all eligible window applications; no averaging an uncollected text subset
definitions.zero: Observed zero only when denominator/source eligible; no firm-level patent link is not proof of zero patents
definitions.limits: Grant selection/right truncation remains for recent filings. Fixed 2024 citation horizon not normalized. Static assignee links not independently fully adjudicated. Partner metrics use usable matched partner portfolios only.

stata_tests.full_test_changes: Output paths only; existing user Stata log left untouched
